decisionSummary: Retain the rich Bureau Sheets app with all 60 bundled FOSS fonts and six icon fonts; contain the toolbar menu's 66 choices and normalize pip launcher wrappers across checkout paths. This source is current on main and dev-publish, and two independent clean SPKs match.
